content.html:
Good to know

Questions

Where do you deliver?

W1, WC1 and WC2 with a £15 minimum; £2.50 delivery fee. Enter your postcode at checkout to check.

Can I order from my table?

Yes — scan the QR card on your table, choose from the menu and pay online or at the table when you leave.

Do you take large groups?

Up to 8 online; for bigger parties and private dining, contact us.

Allergies?

Every dish lists V / VG / GF / N tags. Tell us in the notes and the kitchen ticket flags it.
